verdict: Dynamic media TS cannot retrieve an MP location. The site has multiple Unknown Computer objects per architecture, so the MPLOCATION call returns an ambiguous multi-result set the TS engine refuses to consume.
fix: A site should have exactly one x64 and one x86 Unknown Computer object. Remove duplicates via SQL: `SELECT ItemKey, Name0 FROM System_DISC WHERE Name0 LIKE '%Unknown%' ORDER BY ItemKey`. Leave one of each architecture (the lowest ItemKey is typically the original). Drop duplicates via the console Asset and Compliance workspace; manual DB deletes are unsupported and can corrupt the replication graph.
